question: Which books record ownership, custody, operations and accounting?
answer: The four kinds of books and seven accounting layers describe different jobs. A proprietary balance-sheet entry, a fiduciary register and an operational message are not interchangeable evidence.

groups.note: If this entity’s proprietary books do not debit or credit the economic object, they are not the issuer, holder, CCP, cash settler or reserve owner. A fiduciary file can still be a real role. Transport, software and an unused issuer register have no entry.

catalog_context.title: Who actually controls the crypto infrastructure
catalog_context.answer: Of 20 crypto networks and companies we track, only one is used at scale and none is proven under stress; many brands rest on a handful of legal providers.
